d535a0dbfe40.curator_note: A dedicated day-to-dusk Amelie Lens set at Grand Park, not a shared festival stage — genuinely the better way to catch her than the HARD Summer slot the same month. Extended techno-into-acid-into-trance from a real headliner in a proper Factory 93 room.
d535a0dbfe40.description: Factory 93 presents a solo, day-to-dusk Amelie Lens set (techno, acid, trance) at Grand Park Block 2, DTLA.

artist_notes.name: Polo & Pan
artist_notes.note: French duo (Paul Armand-Delille & Alexandre Grynszpan) doing lush, tropical-tinged synth-pop and disco touches — a strong, Balearic-adjacent opening act even if the headliner isn't your lane.

c24037cc642d.curator_note: Empire of the Sun's costume-heavy glam-pop is out of the house/techno lane, but Polo & Pan opening at the Bowl is worth showing up on time for — their sound leans closer to the Balearic/groove stuff you actually chase.
c24037cc642d.description: Empire of the Sun's 'Ask That God: Afterlife' tour stop at the Hollywood Bowl, with Polo & Pan and Midnight Generation opening.

edab80bd44cb.curator_note: Overmono is a tracked name and this is a proper club date, not a festival slot — the Gawsworth brothers' rave-nostalgic breaks-and-melody sound (Fabric, Warp) translates well to the Palladium's room, with a dedicated Vinyl Room opening early at 6:30.
edab80bd44cb.description: UK duo Overmono's 'Pure Devotion' world tour stops at Hollywood Palladium, doors 8pm with a 6:30pm Vinyl Room opener.

artist_notes.name: Massimiliano Pagliara
artist_notes.note: Italian-born, Berlin-based DJ/producer with residencies at Berghain/Basement — Chicago house, Italo-disco and electro-disco worked through analog '70s/'80s hardware; a genuine Live at Robert Johnson / Ostgut Ton pedigree, deeply in the European lane.

artist_notes.name: James Axon
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ (dublab resident, 'Hearing Color') and founder of the queer underground party Planet Love — deep house, dreamy techno, Italo, Balearic and psych-disco; a real musician's ear (former pianist), has played alongside Octo Octa, Eris Drew, Derrick Carter.

8a862e604d08.curator_note: Massimiliano Pagliara headlining Midnight Lovers is a legitimate European-club booking — Berghain-lineage electro-disco with Masha Mar and James Axon rounding it out with LA's own deep-house/dublab crowd. This is the kind of night the fabric-London comparison is actually built for.
8a862e604d08.description: Midnight Lovers presents Berlin's Massimiliano Pagliara at The Bridge, DTLA, with Masha Mar and James Axon, 9pm.

artist_notes.name: DRAMA
artist_notes.note: Chicago R&B/dance duo — producer Na'el Shehade and vocalist Via Rosa — genre-blurring pop/dance/jazz songwriting; played Coachella alongside Frank Ocean and Gorillaz.

48e360ba751a.curator_note: Sofi Tukker at the Greek is a Spotify-core-rotation lock, not a discovery pick — a fun big-room night if you're already a fan, and DRAMA's a genuinely tasteful opener rather than filler.
48e360ba751a.description: Sofi Tukker headlines the Greek Theatre with support from DRAMA, 7:30pm.

cf044cb77173.curator_note: Indie-disco format built explicitly around Justice/LCD/Disclosure/Daft Punk — the dance-floor-friendly end of indie rather than a real DJ-selection night; fun if you want familiar bangers over discovery, less interesting than the house/techno options this week.
cf044cb77173.description: 'Midnite City: Indie Disco' at The Moroccan Lounge, Arts District, 9:30pm — an indie/electro dance night playing Justice, LCD Soundsystem, Disclosure and similar, with ORLOVE.

artist_notes.name: Gene On Earth
artist_notes.note: San Francisco-born, Berlin-based DJ/producer (Eugene Albert) — runs the Limousine Dream label; deep-digging extended sets drifting through minimal house, breaks and hazy late-night rollers.

3061917831bd.curator_note: Certified Groovers landing Gene On Earth is a nice get — his Limousine Dream sound is more minimal-and-breaks-leaning than most of the TBA-warehouse bills this month, worth it if you want something a shade weirder than straight house.
3061917831bd.description: Certified Groovers presents Gene On Earth at a TBA downtown LA location, 10pm.

artist_notes.name: EMBRZ
artist_notes.note: Dublin producer (Jack Casey) making atmospheric, vocal-forward melodic house — signed to Lane 8's This Never Happened label; downtempo-leaning and emotive rather than peak-time.

ccfacd3e3b24.curator_note: A rooftop sunset set from a This Never Happened-orbit artist is squarely the golden-hour-groove lane — EMBRZ leans dreamier and more vocal than a straight house DJ, good for the early slot rather than the whole night.
ccfacd3e3b24.description: Sunset rooftop set (5pm) at Harbor House DTLA with Dublin melodic-house producer EMBRZ.

artist_notes.name: Isaac Carter
artist_notes.note: London DJ/producer, vocal-led deep house on his own Ochi imprint — championed by Ben UFO, Joy Orbison and Seth Troxler; UK-club lineage (Chicago/Detroit roots filtered through contemporary UK dance).

artist_notes.name: Lubelski
artist_notes.note: LA producer (Jake Lubell) making analog, vinyl-informed house with a wide festival footprint (Lightning in a Bottle, Desert Hearts, Dirtybird Campout) — eclectic and percussive rather than a strict selector.

6a22d168fab3.curator_note: Isaac Carter's UK deep-house pedigree (that Ben UFO/Seth Troxler co-sign carries real weight) makes this a stronger TBA-DTLA afterhours than the billing alone suggests — a legit late-night option once Harrison BDP fills in the middle.
6a22d168fab3.description: TBA-location DTLA afterhours (starts midnight) with London deep-house producer Isaac Carter, Welsh DJ Harrison BDP, and LA's Lubelski.

24a39bacb767.curator_note: A stadium pop show, not the lane — this is here on Spotify-affinity signal alone, not selection or scene fit. Skip unless you're a Karol G fan going for the spectacle itself.
24a39bacb767.description: Karol G's 'Viajando Por El Mundo Tropitour' stadium show at SoFi Stadium, 7pm.

artist_notes.name: DJ Rashida
artist_notes.note: Rashida Gonzalez Robinson — spent a decade as Prince's touring/opening DJ and played his private parties; genuinely the person to trust with a Prince set, not a stunt booking.

1c14235e465f.curator_note: Moodymann and someone who was actually in Prince's inner circle playing his catalog at the Regent is a real pairing, not a novelty theme night — a Detroit deep-house legend's crate plus Rashida's insider Prince knowledge should make for a genuinely soulful room rather than a covers-band vibe.
1c14235e465f.description: Moodymann and DJ Rashida DJ an all-Prince set at The Regent Theater, doors 8pm, 18+.

7de9287d2683.curator_note: No lineup posted yet for this one — same free weekly disco/house format Kiss Kiss Bang Bang always runs, low-stakes and fine as a starter stop, but there's nothing here to build a night around until names drop.
7de9287d2683.description: Paradisco, a recurring disco/house night at Kiss Kiss Bang Bang in Koreatown, 10pm.

artist_notes.name: Man Man
artist_notes.note: Philadelphia-born experimental rock band led by Honus Honus (Ryan Kattner) — theatrical, maximalist arrangements (sousaphone, marimba, toy noisemakers) somewhere between carnival music and art-punk. Toured with Modest Mouse; now LA-based.

artist_notes.name: American Tomahawk
artist_notes.note: LA indie/alt-rock trio (not the Mike Patton supergroup of the same-ish name) — small local footprint, couldn't verify much beyond the billing.

4819e7c77dd7.curator_note: Man Man are the real thing if you want the weird, maximalist end of the live-band lane — theatrical and unpredictable in a way most Echoplex bills aren't. Good pick if you're doing the indie/rock night instead of a dancefloor.
4819e7c77dd7.description: Man Man, the theatrical Philly-born experimental rock band, headlines the Echoplex with American Tomahawk opening, 7pm.

e8925cfb2896.curator_note: This is not tracked-artist FISHER — that's a scoring collision on the name. It's a covers duo doing Sonny & Cher-style 70s rock/disco hits at a Bel Air jazz supper club; fine dinner-and-a-show filler, not a lane pick.
e8925cfb2896.description: Fisher and Thames play a 70s rock-and-disco covers set (a 'modern-day Sonny and Cher') at Vibrato Grill Jazz, 7pm show.

artist_notes.name: Massane
artist_notes.note: French melodic-house producer and guitarist — debut EP and album on Lane 8's This Never Happened, plus a release on mau5trap. Guitar-textured, emotive melodic house that sits right next to the Anjunadeep/Lane 8 end of the spectrum.

cf4ad9ed7a48.curator_note: A real melodic-house name on the bill, not just a pool-party placeholder — Massane's on Lane 8's own label, so expect the same lush, guitar-inflected builds, just poolside at 2pm instead of a dark room at midnight.
cf4ad9ed7a48.description: Daytime rooftop pool party at Level 8 DTLA with French melodic-house producer Massane, 2-8pm.

e8ff8c423d38.curator_note: Full arena pop spectacle at SoFi, not the lane at all — this only shows up on Spotify-affinity, so it's a go-if-you're-actually-a-fan pick, not a curated one.
e8ff8c423d38.description: Karol G's "Viajando Por El Mundo" Tropitour stadium show at SoFi Stadium, 7pm.

artist_notes.name: Maddix
artist_notes.note: Dutch producer known for a hard-hitting techno/big-room/trance crossover (breakout track 'Ecstasy'), Revealed Recordings-affiliated. Mainstage-built and harder-edged than the refined techno end of the lane (Charlotte de Witte, Amelie Lens) — closer to festival trance-techno.

d6d919ad1b86.curator_note: This is festival-mainstage techno-trance at the Palladium, not a selector's night — fun if you want a big, hard-hitting 18+/21+ room, but it's not the fabric-style end of things.
d6d919ad1b86.description: Big-room techno/trance set from Dutch producer Maddix at Hollywood Palladium, 10pm, 18+/21+.

28b893e6e79d.curator_note: The Fast and the Furious turns 25 — a fun communal big-screen outing at the Vista, but it's blockbuster nostalgia more than a rep-cinema curation pick.
28b893e6e79d.description: 25th-anniversary theatrical screening of The Fast and the Furious (2001) at the Vista Theater, Los Feliz.

artist_notes.name: Steven G
artist_notes.note: Bay Area hip-hop MC known for tracks like 'Pull Up' and 'Bag' — smooth, narrative-driven flow (not the Miami freestyle DJ who shares the name).

artist_notes.name: Tayy Tarantino
artist_notes.note: Anchorage, Alaska rapper — a rare touring booking from a small but real regional scene; has opened for Nas and Wu-Tang Clan up north.

artist_notes.name: Pofsky
artist_notes.note: LA-via-805 singer/songwriter signed to Eric Bellinger's All Wins Entertainment — melodic, R&B-leaning hip-hop; also co-runs UNDRGRND Magazine.

6752c300c13f.curator_note: Solid local hip-hop bill, but nothing here is chasing the desert-blues/garage-rock spine she actually lives in — fine if she's already at The Echo that night, not a reason to go out of your way.
6752c300c13f.description: A hip-hop bill at The Echo headlined by Bay Area rapper Steven G, with support from Anchorage's Tayy Tarantino and LA's Pofsky.

91f0311556ce.description: margo live rock performance at The Moroccan Lounge (Arts District), all-ages, $15, doors 6:30pm.

23bdb5b41cf4.description: Eslabon Armado live at YouTube Theater (Inglewood), 8pm.

artist_notes.name: JOHN
artist_notes.note: London two-piece — John Newton (drums/vocals) and Johnny Healey (guitar), both named John — self-managed, self-released post-punk duo built on volume and simplicity rather than polish.

artist_notes.name: French Perfume
artist_notes.note: LA indie-rock band; thin public footprint beyond a handful of singles ('Bonnie') — a smaller local opener, not a known quantity.

0ec7074e8d8a.curator_note: A scrappy, DIY post-punk bill at the Moroccan — JOHN is a genuinely loud two-piece worth the volume, paired with a barely-documented local opener; small-room band night, not a headline event.
0ec7074e8d8a.description: UK post-punk two-piece JOHN plays The Moroccan Lounge with LA indie band French Perfume (doors 9:30pm, 21+).

3e976b515868.description: Country artist Megan Moroney at Crypto.com Arena (DTLA), 7pm.

artist_notes.name: The Beths
artist_notes.note: Auckland, NZ four-piece — sharp, hook-driven indie rock, consistently well-reviewed (Pitchfork/NPR) over several albums.

artist_notes.name: Beach Bunny
artist_notes.note: Chicago's Lili Trifilio-led indie-pop project — broke out with the viral 'Prom Queen,' has since grown into a full-band, hookier sound.

0016dfad8af5.curator_note: Two of the better hook-driven indie rock/pop bands going right now — worth the Pomona trek if you're an indie-guitar person, even though it's well outside the usual eastside radius.
0016dfad8af5.description: New Zealand indie rock band The Beths co-headlines the Fox Theater Pomona with Chicago's Beach Bunny.

228005af5a28.description: Juan De Marcos and Afro-Cuban All Stars at The United Theater on Broadway (DTLA), 8pm.

f8c8272f43ca.description: O.A.R. Three Decades Tour with Gavin DeGraw and Lisa Loeb at the Greek Theatre (Los Feliz), 6:30pm.

artist_notes.name: Driveways
artist_notes.note: Massachusetts pop-punk trio touring on raw, hook-heavy songs like 'Fifteen Minutes' — headlining this all-ages Teragram stop.

artist_notes.name: Like Roses
artist_notes.note: Berkeley emo/pop-punk band whose 2023 single 'Easy' broke out (1M+ streams); direct support on this tour.

artist_notes.name: Action/Adventure
artist_notes.note: Touring pop-punk band rounding out the bill alongside Like Roses on this Driveways run.

3e33fdb8bb49.curator_note: This isn't the rooftop-house lane at all — straight all-ages pop-punk/emo — but as the live-band side of the taste goes, three real touring bands on one bill beats a single support slot as an afterthought.
3e33fdb8bb49.description: All-ages pop-punk/emo bill headlined by Driveways with Like Roses and Action/Adventure at Teragram Ballroom, Westlake, Sat 8/8, doors 7pm, $22-25.

artist_notes.name: Strange Case
artist_notes.note: LA rock band, road-tested over 8+ years of SoCal gigging — KROQ 'Locals Only' airplay and a Netflix sync (The Lincoln Lawyer); dropping a new album, 'Gone For a While,' the day before this show.

d95b156bb459.curator_note: Strange Case is a solid, road-tested SoCal rock band timing an album release show around this — a decent, unpretentious local rock bill, not something that demands a special trip.

artist_notes.name: Mexican Institute of Sound
artist_notes.note: Camilo Lara's long-running Mexico City project — cumbia, mambo and sonidero samples run through electronic production; a Latin Grammy-nominated producer and former EMI Mexico exec who co-founded Suave Records.

d240aa4d35ce.curator_note: Two of the sharpest minds in Latin alternative on one stage — Eblis Álvarez's surreal, tape-warped take on cumbia and vallenato next to Camilo Lara's sample-heavy Mexico City funk. They've even recorded a collaborative album together, so expect them to trade songs.
d240aa4d35ce.description: A Latin-alternative double bill at the Regent Theater: Colombia's avant-cumbia Meridian Brothers and Mexico City's electro-cumbia project Mexican Institute of Sound.

artist_notes.name: Oguz
artist_notes.note: Dutch-Turkish techno DJ/producer — high-tempo, hard-driving peak-time techno, a regular on the international festival/club circuit. Refined-end-of-techno rather than melodic.

a4fbb098114f.curator_note: Straight peak-time techno at Exchange LA's Mutate series — no groove or daytime softness here, this is a full-tempo club night for when that's the mood.
a4fbb098114f.description: Mutate techno night at Exchange LA featuring Dutch-Turkish techno DJ Oguz.

artist_notes.name: Noizu
artist_notes.note: UK-born, now LA-based tech-house producer (real name Jacob Plant) — runs his own label TECHNE Records, broke through via Chris Lake/Skrillex's HOWSLA and the platinum single 'Summer 91.' Crowd-pleasing but well-crafted house/tech-house, the mainstream end of the lane this taste explicitly wants.

e653cbe40068.curator_note: Noizu's the kind of big-tent tech-house that earns its Spotify rotation honestly — not the deepest cut of the night but a properly good one for a bigger room like the Shrine.
e653cbe40068.description: Tech-house DJ Noizu headlines a dance show at Shrine Expo Hall.

880d4a67db6c.curator_note: A 25th-anniversary big-screen Fast & Furious at the Vista is pure popcorn nostalgia rather than the arthouse rep-cinema lane, but it's the Vista and it'll be a rowdy, fun crowd for it.
880d4a67db6c.description: 25th-anniversary screening of the original Fast and the Furious at the Vista Theater.

artist_notes.name: Durante
artist_notes.note: Italian-born, LA-based progressive/melodic house producer on Anjunadeep — hypnotic, groove-driven sets sitting between deep house and techno; released his debut album 'Enter' on Anjunadeep in 2024, collaborators include Amtrac and Diplo. Same melodic/Anjuna orbit as Lane 8 and Yotto.

dcc3f7d675a5.curator_note: A rooftop pool party with an Anjunadeep-orbit melodic house DJ is about as close to the Sunset Sessions feeling as it gets on a random weekday afternoon — this is the one to build the day around.
dcc3f7d675a5.description: Daytime rooftop pool party at Level 8 DTLA featuring Anjunadeep producer Durante, 2-8pm.

a56bf892f5d4.curator_note: Chai Rave is LA's South Asian/Bollywood party crew, not a European-house night — same great Level 8 rooftop as Sunset Sessions, but the sound is Indo-house/Bollywood-fusion rather than the deep groove lane, so go for the room and the vibe, not expecting a fabric-style set.
a56bf892f5d4.description: One-year-anniversary rooftop day party from Chai Rave LA (South Asian/Bollywood-fusion party series) at Level 8 DTLA.

artist_notes.name: DJ Susan
artist_notes.note: Alias of Steven Glathe (Hood Politics Records, San Diego) — bass/tech-house built for big builds and gritty drops, several Beatport #1s. More festival-EDM energy than a groove selector.

f78e396da172.curator_note: Labor Day rooftop pool party checks the setting boxes (near home, Saturday, open-air), but DJ Susan is a build-and-drop bass-house guy, not a digger — go for the pool and the day-drinking, not a deep set.
f78e396da172.description: Labor Day Saturday daytime pool party (2-8pm) at Level 8's rooftop deck headlined by bass/tech-house DJ Susan.

d8703a4e567c.curator_note: No lineup posted yet for this one — it's the same Paradisco disco-house residency at Kiss Kiss Bang Bang that brings Scotty Boy back two weeks later, so probably the house DJs, but worth a lineup check before committing a Saturday night to it.
d8703a4e567c.description: Late-night (10pm) disco/house party in the Paradisco series at Kiss Kiss Bang Bang, Koreatown — lineup TBA.

artist_notes.name: Bayymack
artist_notes.note: LA-based artist blending hip-hop, pop and rock (alt-hip-hop/'scene' crossover — collabs with 6arelyhuman, Lil Raven) — not a DJ/producer in the house-techno sense.

3311cff0ac9d.curator_note: This reads as a Y2K/'scene'-revival night built around Bayymack's hip-hop-pop, not a house or techno booking — fun if you're into that throwback-emo-rap aesthetic, but it's not really your lane despite the late-night 1720 slot.
3311cff0ac9d.description: Late-night (10pm) Y2K-themed 'scene' party at 1720 in the Arts District with alt-hip-hop artist Bayymack.

artist_notes.name: Apache
artist_notes.note: Miami-based, French-born DJ/producer on Abracadabra Records (Miami house/techno label) and founder of the Soundtuary party series — warm, groove-driven house suited to a rooftop-pool crowd.

e46641e7b265.curator_note: A genuine rooftop-pool day party — Apache isn't a name you'll recognize, but Abracadabra's house lane is legit groove, not brostep-adjacent EDM, and the setting alone (2-8pm, DTLA rooftop) is the Sunset-Sessions kind of afternoon you like.
e46641e7b265.description: Daytime rooftop pool party (2-8pm) at Level 8 DTLA headlined by Miami house DJ Apache.

artist_notes.name: Scotty Boy
artist_notes.note: Vegas-based house veteran (25+ years, three Billboard Dance #1s) and founder of DTLA's long-running 'Deep House Brunch' — plays crowd-friendly deep/jackin' house and nu-disco edits, more festival-polish than underground digger.

307344a761b7.curator_note: Same Scotty Boy energy you'd expect from him anywhere — reliable jackin'-house-and-disco-edits, but it's closer to populist brunch-party polish than a proper selector's after-hours set.
307344a761b7.description: Late-night (10pm) disco/house party at Kiss Kiss Bang Bang in Koreatown headlined by house DJ/producer Scotty Boy.

artist_notes.name: Rich Medina
artist_notes.note: Philly institution, 25+ years in — founder of Jump n Funk (North America's original Afrobeat party) and one of the great genre-agnostic all-night selectors, moving through house, soul, afrobeat, funk, breaks and rare groove.

2c126d230d6c.curator_note: An open-to-close Rich Medina set billed explicitly as house/rare-groove/garage is exactly the deep-crate education worth clearing a whole Saturday night for at a tiki bar like High Tide.
2c126d230d6c.description: All-night open-to-close set (10pm) from Philly selector Rich Medina — house, rare groove and garage classics — at High Tide's Little Tokyo/Arts District bar.

artist_notes.name: Dublon
artist_notes.note: Oslo producer/DJ who went viral on TikTok with jazz-inflected house ('Summer in Marseile,' 'belle') — his 'Nectar' EP features jazz saxophonist Nathan Haines; real touring history across European clubs (London's Jazz Café) despite the social-media breakout.

bf5bb21c979b.curator_note: TikTok-viral is a red flag on paper, but the jazz-house sound is legit and a 5pm rooftop slot at Harbor House is the right room for it — closer to a sunset groove set than a hype booking.
bf5bb21c979b.description: 5pm sunset rooftop party at Harbor House DTLA headlined by Oslo jazz-house producer Dublon.

artist_notes.name: Gabriella Rose
artist_notes.note: Coeur d'Alene singer-songwriter blending vintage country, indie folk and pop — broke through as the featured vocalist on Zach Bryan's 'Madeline.' Opening this leg of Kacey's tour.

6d1613301e21.curator_note: Not remotely the club lane, but Kacey's a real Spotify staple for you and this is the 'Middle of Nowhere' arena tour hitting DTLA — go for the songs, not the scene.
6d1613301e21.description: Kacey Musgraves' 'Middle of Nowhere' arena tour at Crypto.com Arena, with singer-songwriter Gabriella Rose opening.

artist_notes.name: Estevie
artist_notes.note: LA-based mainstream-pop artist — catchy, hooky songwriting, not a name outside pop-radio circles. Opening this second DTLA date on Kacey's tour.

c5a4ec16269a.curator_note: Same arena run as the night before, just a different opener (LA pop act Estevie instead of Gabriella Rose) — pick whichever date works, the calculus doesn't change.
c5a4ec16269a.description: Kacey Musgraves' 'Middle of Nowhere' arena tour, second Crypto.com Arena date, with pop artist Estevie opening.

artist_notes.name: Pigeons Playing Ping Pong
artist_notes.note: Baltimore funk/jam band — extended improvisational jams over a funk-rock base, built around a dedicated touring jam-scene fanbase rather than club culture.

999952fc903e.curator_note: This is a proper jam band, not remotely house or techno, but Teragram is one of the better small rooms in the city for a live set and a funk-forward jam show there on a Friday is a fine change of pace if you're not chasing a DJ that night.
999952fc903e.description: Baltimore funk/jam band Pigeons Playing Ping Pong's Fall Tour stop at Teragram Ballroom.

7474456564c6.description: Daytime dance party at DTLA's The Bridge headlined by an extended set from Paris tech-house veteran Shonky, with Silky, Enzo Muro and Lubelski.
7474456564c6.curator_note: Shonky's extended set is the real draw — a founding third of the Apollonia crew doing groovy, stripped-back house — and Dialogue's own resident Enzo Muro plus LA's Lubelski keep the afternoon honest.

artist_notes.name: Shonky
artist_notes.note: Paris house/tech-house lifer (Olivier Ducreux) — a third of the Apollonia trio with Dan Ghenacia and Dyed Soundorom; groovy, stripped-back underground house, well-suited to an extended set.

artist_notes.name: Silky
artist_notes.note: London house/techno DJ mentored by Frankie Knuckles — works the grey zone between deep house and techno, with releases on Culprit and My Favorite Robot.

artist_notes.name: Enzo Muro
artist_notes.note: Peruvian-born, LA-based house/techno selector and a resident of Dialogue itself — patient, flow-first sets; also co-runs the vinyl-only YouKnowWhat label/party.

artist_notes.name: Lubelski
artist_notes.note: LA producer (Jake Lubell) making analog, vinyl-informed house with a wide festival footprint (Lightning in a Bottle, Desert Hearts, Dirtybird Campout) — eclectic and percussive rather than a strict selector.

36aa6be5efaf.curator_note: Redondo Beach is a real haul from the eastside, but Colette's a legit vocal-house veteran rather than generic tropical-party filler — worth it only if you're already down that way for the night.

artist_notes.note: German producer on Anjunadeep — melodic/progressive house, tours with a live band rather than just decks, same Anjuna-orbit lane as Lane 8 and Yotto and a genuinely good opener for this bill.

2ae4c53899f3.curator_note: This is the arena tour, not a club night, but Rüfüs is a tracked name for a reason and Ben Böhmer's live Anjunadeep set is worth showing up on time for.

artist_notes.name: Tauceti (FR)
artist_notes.note: French techno/ambient producer with a growing profile in that scene — couldn't pin down a label home, so treat this as a promising rather than proven booking.

artist_notes.name: Mha iri
artist_notes.note: Edinburgh-raised, Melbourne-forged techno DJ/producer — big-room-meets-emotional sound with her own vocals, now signed to PIAS and releasing on Adam Beyer's Drumcode; genuinely on the rise (Awakenings, Tomorrowland, Hï Ibiza in the last year).

artist_notes.name: Gerard Not Gerald
artist_notes.note: Co-founder and resident of INCOGNITO itself (formerly Franco Benito) — has held down LA's underground techno scene for over a decade, sharing decks with Kevin Saunderson, Kenny Larkin and DJ Pierre.

1c5658a19b7d.curator_note: Mha iri's Drumcode pedigree is the real signal here — a proper warehouse booking from a promoter that's been quietly building LA's underground techno scene for a decade.
1c5658a19b7d.description: INCOGNITO's warehouse techno night (TBA location) with touring names Tauceti (FR) and Mha iri (UK), hosted by INCOGNITO co-founder Gerard Not Gerald.

6ee76fc1b912.description: Daytime house party at Cielo Farms in Malibu with Hot Creations/Repopulate Mars co-founder Lee Foss and Henry Pope.
6ee76fc1b912.curator_note: Lee Foss headlining is a legit underground-house booking, but Malibu on a random Saturday afternoon is a real haul unless you're already out that way.

artist_notes.name: Lee Foss
artist_notes.note: Chicago-schooled house lifer out of DeKalb, IL — co-founded Hot Creations with Jamie Jones and later launched Repopulate Mars; a real name in modern underground house, not just a big-festival booking.

artist_notes.name: Henry Pope
artist_notes.note: Venice Beach-based producer running his own Genius Loci/Fresh Tracks/Sense labels — Beatport #1 indie-dance and afro-house releases, sets that fold in live musicians.

5612232b8c1a.description: Upon Your Dead Body and Primrose at The Echo, Echo Park (7pm).

af54b8c37360.description: CORTIS <Put Your Phone Down> tour at YouTube Theater, Inglewood (8pm).

86dfaf8f2a46.description: Lizdek LA and Midnight Society electronic event at a secret DTLA location (9pm).

artist_notes.name: Alan Fitzpatrick
artist_notes.note: UK techno heavyweight and founder of We Are The Brave — driving, peak-time techno that tours the same circuit as Adam Beyer/Drumcode-tier bills; a legit headliner in the European techno lane.

artist_notes.name: Anastasia Giovani
artist_notes.note: SoCal-raised, now a fixture of LA's underground techno scene (SXTCY resident, founder of the VSCRL event series) — dark, textured, experimental techno sets.

artist_notes.name: Greg Downey
artist_notes.note: Belfast-born DJ/producer and founder of the Skullduggery label — started in trance (his 'Stadium' was Mixmag's Cream Ibiza anthem of 2008) before moving into deeper underground techno via his R.I.C.O alias.

9111f44bad10.curator_note: A TBA-warehouse techno bill anchored by Alan Fitzpatrick's proper peak-time European sound, with Greg Downey's own Skullduggery imprint and LA underground regular Anastasia Giovani rounding it out — a real late one if you're up for it.
9111f44bad10.description: TBA-location late-night techno party (WORK x Skullduggery) with Alan Fitzpatrick, Anastasia Giovani, Greg Downey, 11pm.

artist_notes.name: Luigi Amore
artist_notes.note: Recurring name on LA pool/rooftop day-party bills like Sex with The City — not enough reliably sourced info to characterize the sound with confidence.

artist_notes.name: Evo Twinz
artist_notes.note: LA duo billed as melodic-techno/tribal producers — a support-tier name on this recurring series, thinly documented beyond that.

418949ff3763.curator_note: Sex with The City's rooftop/pool day-party formula is a fun setting in the right mood, but this particular billing (Luigi Amore, Evo Twinz) is thin on documented pedigree — go for the vibe, not name recognition.
418949ff3763.description: TBA-location rooftop/pool day party (Sex with The City: Sunset Summer Sessions series) with Luigi Amore and Evo Twinz, 5pm.

d88055842815.description: Earlybirds Club electronic event at The Bellwether DTLA (6pm).

artist_notes.name: Gun Outfit
artist_notes.note: Olympia-turned-LA psych/post-punk band on Post Present Medium since their 2008 debut EP — a foundational act for the label being celebrated.

artist_notes.name: The Spatulas
artist_notes.note: Bloomington, IN lo-fi punk band on the Post Present Medium roster.

artist_notes.name: Chronophage
artist_notes.note: Austin DIY punk four-piece with a sophisticated, transgressive songwriting bent — two LPs and a run of cassettes deep.

artist_notes.name: Guiding Light
artist_notes.note: Austin punk band singing bilingually in German/English over jangly, hyper-strummed garage — their debut LP just came out on Post Present Medium.

artist_notes.name: Semi Trucks
artist_notes.note: LA art-pop project fronted by Brendan Sepe, grown from a solo bedroom effort into a full band — scrappy, melodic songs.

artist_notes.name: Muscle Beach
artist_notes.note: LA four-piece delivering noisy, scattershot 'party band' improvisations — a Smell regular.

artist_notes.name: Kate Hall
artist_notes.note: No Age/Mika Miko/Dunes-adjacent LA musician (half of the News Feeds project with Luke Fischbeck & Dean Spunt) DJing the night.

9df4c24ef8b4.curator_note: A real DIY institution's 25th birthday at its natural home — Gun Outfit anchors a bill of scrappy touring bands (Spatulas, Chronophage, Guiding Light) that reads like a Post Present Medium family reunion, not a nostalgia cash-grab.
9df4c24ef8b4.description: Post Present Medium's 25th-anniversary all-ages show at The Smell: Gun Outfit, The Spatulas, Chronophage, Guiding Light, Semi Trucks, Muscle Beach, plus DJ Kate Hall, 7:30pm.

7b479b4668da.description: Electronic event with DJ Perception, Louiv, Highkin', and Dylan Schwartz by MARBLE and Texture Summit (8pm, TBA DTLA).

artist_notes.note: Connecticut jam band (formed 2014) with a devoted, Phish-adjacent live following built on lengthy improvisation — outside the usual electronic/indie lane here but a real, well-loved live act, and the Greek is a favorite room. (Note: 'jam-band' isn't yet in the subgenre vocab; flagging rather than inventing a tag.)

a940acee75c4.curator_note: Goose isn't the usual electronic/rock lane, but they've built a genuine Phish-tier improv following, and the Greek is one of the better rooms in the city to catch that kind of show — mostly a heads-up if jam bands are your thing.
a940acee75c4.description: Jam band Goose (KCSN Presents) at the Greek Theatre, 7pm; $1/ticket benefits Western Sun Foundation.

artist_notes.name: Momma
artist_notes.note: Brooklyn duo-fronted band (Etta Friedman, Allegra Weingarten) doing loving, well-executed 90s alt-rock/grunge revival — Polyvinyl, breakout album 'Household Name.'

artist_notes.name: Rocket
artist_notes.note: LA alt-rock band (formed 2021) with a shoegaze-leaning edge — recently opened arena dates for Smashing Pumpkins.

f5fa123eb456.curator_note: Momma's 90s-alt-revival sound (Breeders/Nirvana worship done really well) plus Rocket's shoegaze-tinged support makes for a solid rock bill if you want guitars over four-on-the-floor for a night.
f5fa123eb456.description: Brooklyn 90s-alt-revival band Momma headlines The Bellwether with LA's Rocket and Dan English opening.

artist_notes.name: The Womack Sisters
artist_notes.note: LA soul trio (BG, Zeimani, Kucha) carrying serious family lineage — daughters of Cecil & Linda Womack, granddaughters of Sam Cooke, niece/nephews of Bobby Womack; debuting their self-titled Daptone Records album the same day as this show.

fb112c9c7dc6.curator_note: Al Green at the Hollywood Bowl is about as close to a guaranteed classic night as this city offers, and the Womack Sisters — Sam Cooke's granddaughters, dropping a Daptone debut that day — are a genuinely meaningful opener, not a placeholder.
fb112c9c7dc6.description: Soul legend Al Green headlines the Hollywood Bowl, with The Womack Sisters opening on the release day of their Daptone Records debut album.

artist_notes.name: Will Swinton
artist_notes.note: Auckland-born, now LA-based pop songwriter — bedroom-pop turned Capitol signee, gravelly-voiced and TikTok-friendly; drew notice from Machine Gun Kelly after a chance meeting.

8926af10ee3c.curator_note: Radio-ready alt-pop in the Kid Laroi vein — pleasant enough, but closer to the mainstream end of her craft-pop tolerance than to Mitski or Olivia Rodrigo's specificity.
8926af10ee3c.description: New Zealand-born, LA-based pop songwriter Will Swinton headlines The Echo.

artist_notes.name: Iwrotehaikusaboutcannibalisminyouryearbook
artist_notes.note: Bay Area screamo band (Antioch, CA) from the mid-2000s skramz wave, broken up 2007, reactivated in 2020 — a real scene-history booking for genre diehards, outside the digest's usual electronic/rock lane.

artist_notes.name: Loma Prieta
artist_notes.note: Long-running Bay Area screamo band (since 2004) — a foundational, still-active name in the skramz revival, chaotic and dissonant.

artist_notes.name: Nuvolascura
artist_notes.note: LA screamo/mathcore four-piece (formerly Vril) blending skramz with technical, dissonant hardcore — one of the genre's current top-tier acts.

artist_notes.name: Ferry Corsten
artist_notes.note: Dutch trance OG since the late-90s boom (System F, Gouryella with a young Tiësto) who now runs his own Flashover label and plays a broader, more contemporary progressive-leaning set. Real lineage in the genre, but this is Avalon's mainstream Friday circuit, not an underground booking.

ea64a8bc0c7b.curator_note: Corsten's an actual architect of trance rather than a festival-era arrival, but there's nothing special about this date beyond that — go if trance/prog is genuinely your night, skip if you want something more curated.

artist_notes.name: JKS
artist_notes.note: French DJ/producer (Valentin De Sieter) based in Berlin — percussive, hypnotic techno that draws on UK bass and broken techno; cites Randomer as a direct influence.

artist_notes.name: Randomer
artist_notes.note: North London producer (Rohan Walder), one of the more prolific UK techno names of the last decade — releases on Hessle Audio, L.I.E.S. and Numbers; deep, spatial techno that pulls in dubstep and garage markers.

5bd7f81cf3e4.curator_note: Randomer's percussive, textured techno (Hessle Audio/L.I.E.S. pedigree) anchors this, with JKS bringing a harder, more chaotic UK-bass-adjacent set — a real underground techno bill if the TBA venue delivers.

artist_notes.name: Abe Vigoda
artist_notes.note: LA experimental/'tropical punk' band from the mid-2000s Smell scene, on Post Present Medium — jittery, humid, post-punk-meets-tropicalia; this run is a reunion set for the label's anniversary.

artist_notes.name: Callahan & Witscher
artist_notes.note: NYC duo of two veteran underground experimentalists (Jack Callahan, aka die Reihe; Jeff Witscher, aka Rene Hell) whose new project is a surprising, hooky pivot toward songs after years of noise/ambient work.

artist_notes.name: Debt Rag
artist_notes.note: Olympia, WA punk trio (former members of Grass Widow and Girlsperm) playing guitarless, clattering, drum-and-keyboard punk — Post Present Medium's 2023 LP 'Lost to the Fantasy.'

artist_notes.name: The Intima
artist_notes.note: Portland post-punk quartet, violin-driven, active 1999-2004 and recently reunited — shared stages with The Rapture and The Mekons back in the day; PPM reissued their 'Peril and Panic' LP.

0215505472f1.curator_note: Three nights deep into Post Present Medium's 25th-anniversary run and this one's genuinely stacked — Abe Vigoda's tropical-punk reunion, Callahan & Witscher's weird new pivot into actual songs, and DIY lifers Debt Rag and reunited Portland post-punk act The Intima. This is the Smell's classic guitars-and-noise lane, not the club side of things.
0215505472f1.description: Night three of The Smell's Post Present Medium 25th-anniversary celebration: reunited LA tropical-punk band Abe Vigoda, experimental duo Callahan & Witscher, Olympia's Debt Rag, and reunited Portland post-punk band The Intima.

artist_notes.name: Harmony Holiday
artist_notes.note: LA poet, dancer, and archivist — daughter of soul singer-songwriter Jimmy Holiday, who died when she was five — whose books (Negro League Baseball, Go Find Your Father) and live performances work through jazz/soul history and Black avant-garde archives. Closer to a lecture-performance than a set.

86d48f0b672d.curator_note: Not a DJ set or a band bill — Harmony Holiday builds a live piece out of jazz history and her father's soul-music lineage, and 2220 is exactly the kind of small serious room where that actually lands.

artist_notes.name: DJ Bone
artist_notes.note: Detroit techno lifer (Eric Dulan), founder of Subject Detroit — deep, hypnotic, no-filler techno from someone who's been doing it since the '90s underground scene.

artist_notes.name: Stacey Hotwaxx Hale
artist_notes.note: Detroit house pioneer often called the 'Godmother of House' — spinning since the late '70s/'80s at clubs like Chessmate and Todd's, one of the first women behind the decks in the genre's birthplace.

artist_notes.name: Mapamota
artist_notes.note: LA DJ and event producer (behind Direct Drive, Serenity Link, Soul Swap) — house, afrobeats, techno and global club rhythms, built around percussive, high-energy sets.

623a61c809c9.curator_note: A TBA-location afterhours booking with real lineage for once — DJ Bone and Stacey Hotwaxx Hale are actual Detroit techno/house pioneers, not just another anonymous warehouse bill.
623a61c809c9.description: INCOGNITO and Dirty Epic present an 11pm afterhours set with Detroit techno/house pioneers DJ Bone and Stacey Hotwaxx Hale alongside Mapamota, location TBA.

artist_notes.name: Afriqua
artist_notes.note: Adam Longman Parker — Virginia-born, Berlin-based producer on R&S Records; his 2019 LP 'Colored' fused deep house/techno with an explicit Black-culture lens. A genuinely respected, thoughtful name — arguably the most substantive booking on this bill.

artist_notes.name: Azzecca
artist_notes.note: Chicago DJ/producer (Allie DeCastris) and COSIMEA label boss — cosmic, dark, disco-inflected house/techno; a Beatport 'Next Artist' for 2025 who's shared bills with Tale of Us and CamelPhat.

artist_notes.name: Ray Kash
artist_notes.note: LA underground fixture since 2010 (Temple Tuesdays resident) — deep house into techno and melodic, weaned on Danny Tenaglia/Jonathan Peters-style New York house.

4b408a85f3df.curator_note: Afriqua alone is worth the trip to DTLA — R&S-signed, one of the more substantive deep house/techno voices around — and Azzecca/Ray Kash round it into a real groove-forward bill rather than another generic warehouse night.
4b408a85f3df.description: DTLA club date led by R&S producer Afriqua, with Chicago's Azzecca and LA local Ray Kash.

artist_notes.name: Rival Consoles
artist_notes.note: Ryan Lee West — UK producer on Erased Tapes known for guitar-and-modular-laced, emotionally heavy electronic/ambient records ('Persona', 'Now Is'); closer to Jon Hopkins/Nils Frahm territory than a club DJ set.

artist_notes.name: Khotin
artist_notes.note: Edmonton producer (Dylan Khotin-Foote) on Ghostly International — warm, hazy ambient-house; a gentle, textural opener.

59bcb69a1173.curator_note: Not a club night — Rival Consoles is heady, modular-and-guitar electronic in the Jon Hopkins/Nils Frahm vein, and Khotin's hazy ambient-house is the right warm-up. A good pick if you want to actually sit and listen for once.
59bcb69a1173.description: Live electronic/ambient set from UK's Rival Consoles (Erased Tapes) with support from Ghostly International's Khotin at Teragram Ballroom.

artist_notes.name: Joris Voorn
artist_notes.note: Dutch mainstay of melodic techno-house since the mid-2000s (his own Green and Rejected labels) — the 'Nobody Knows' album won Billboard's Electronic Album of the Year in 2014. Widescreen, emotive, festival-capable; not on the tracked list but a real headliner, closer to Solomun/Tale of Us than pure techno.

artist_notes.name: LUIS MIRANDA
artist_notes.note: Madrid-born, LA-based techno producer on Tronic and KD Raw — driving peak-time techno with real co-signs (Richie Hawtin, Rødhåd support his tracks); a legit local name, not filler support.

artist_notes.name: Materielle
artist_notes.note: LA techno producer/DJ steeped in '90s Detroit — dub-heavy, hypnotic, texture-first sets; still building a catalog (Delusi EPs) but a thoughtful selector.

8a34951dcd50.curator_note: Joris Voorn headlining a TBA-location night is a genuine catch — he's been putting out widescreen, emotive techno-house for two decades — and the local support here (Luis Miranda, Materielle) is real rather than an afterthought.
8a34951dcd50.description: TBA-location club night led by longtime Dutch melodic techno-house mainstay Joris Voorn, with LA techno support Luis Miranda and Materielle.

artist_notes.name: Paolo Ferrara
artist_notes.note: Italian 'Heavy Destroyer' behind TechnoMetal — hard techno fused with metal aggression and industrial noise, co-founder of the HEX movement; his 'Last Resort' hit #1 on Beatport's Hard Techno chart in 2024. A much harder, more extreme booking than the rooftop-groove lane, closer to Sara Landry's crowd.

artist_notes.name: Elise Ember
artist_notes.note: LA 'second-generation' techno DJ working the local hard/heavy techno circuit (SXTCY, Closer.LA).

artist_notes.name: KriStyle
artist_notes.note: LA hard techno/schranz DJ building a following in the local warehouse and afterhours scene.

32e506bb3cfe.curator_note: Paolo Ferrara's 'TechnoMetal' is genuinely extreme — industrial-metal aggression bolted onto hard techno — so know what you're walking into; it's a real scene (HEX, Beatport #1s), just not the groove end of the spectrum.
32e506bb3cfe.description: Warehouse hard techno night marking Italian TechnoMetal artist Paolo Ferrara's LA debut, with local support Elise Ember and KriStyle.

e37fb1d2d8c0.description: Drum and bass night with Voltage and AC13 (10pm).

artist_notes.name: Boris
artist_notes.note: Longtime Berlin techno figure — SWXCH bills him as a Berghain/Panorama Bar resident, and this is his ongoing residency there (volume 7 now); decades of stripped-back, hypnotic techno for queer dancefloors. (Note: there's more than one touring 'Boris' — this bio follows SWXCH's own description of their resident.)

artist_notes.name: John Bryars
artist_notes.note: LA local, eclectic acid/techno/electro/EBM selector who's played A Club Called Rhonda and Boiler Room — a good bet for a genuinely varied warm-up set.

artist_notes.name: Kittamami
artist_notes.note: Detroit-bred, LA-based DJ/producer blending house and techno with empowering vocal-driven tracks; active across the local warehouse scene.

38fb45a7c54c.curator_note: SWXCH keeps landing real Berlin names for a TBA warehouse — Boris's residency is now seven volumes deep — and John Bryars/Kittamami round out a genuinely varied local undercard rather than filler.
38fb45a7c54c.description: Warehouse techno night built around Boris's ongoing SWXCH residency, with LA selectors John Bryars and Kittamami opening.

artist_notes.note: Hamburg-via-Berlin producer, founder of Stil vor Talent (20 years running) — his 2005 track 'Der Mückenschwarm' on Sven Väth's Cocoon helped define the melodic-house wave that came after. Big, emotive, festival-ready; closer to Dixon/Adriatique than deep underground.

6f3b45e0c905.curator_note: Koletzki's been doing the big-room-but-emotive melodic house thing since before it was a genre label — a solid, reliable pick if you want groove without going full techno.

A genuinely musical selector, not just a functional house DJ.

artist_notes.note: American structuralist filmmaker — Talking to Strangers (1988) is his triple-threat debut (writer/director/cinematographer): nine unbroken 10-minute 35mm takes, shot once each, sequenced by computer-randomized order. The NYT called it an antidote to jazzy montage; a genuine formalist curio, not a normal narrative feature.

artist_notes.name: Dor Wand
artist_notes.note: dublab resident (Open Heart Social Club) and Basement-affiliated ambient artist/DJ — opens sets in live ambient before shifting into soulful house and Balearic, literally this party's own format.

artist_notes.name: Xica Soul
artist_notes.note: LA selector (Daniela Zepeda) with residencies across dublab, Hyde FM and NTS — genre-spanning soulful sets moving between disco, house and everything between.

artist_notes.name: Sonrisita
artist_notes.note: dublab resident and record digger (Melissa Dueñas) behind Lowrider Sundays and the Eastside Story Project — boogie, disco and soul rooted in SoCal oldies culture.

artist_notes.name: Natuta
artist_notes.note: Tbilisi/LA DJ and co-founder of eau_de_cologne_tbs, the queer party series tied to Georgia's Bassiani club scene.

artist_notes.name: Things You Say
artist_notes.note: LA club-scene DJ project posting house mixes and playing local nights — low profile, nothing more substantial to verify.

artist_notes.name: Juliet Mendoza
artist_notes.note: 25-year LA house scene veteran, founder of Jill's House (Jackin' Jills) and a 2022 Defected Unsung Hero — dancer-rooted, deep and soulful selections.

artist_notes.name: Perfect Lovers
artist_notes.note: LA DJ (Celice Monnette) and co-founder of the Mexico City/LA queer warehouse series Por Detroit and the Muy Muy label — house and techno with a queer-community throughline.

artist_notes.name: Lovefingers
artist_notes.note: Andrew Hogge — LA-based Balearic/disco digger and 'shaman' of ESP Institute, the label/party he's run for two decades; a longtime DJ Harvey collaborator in the same cosmic-disco lineage.

artist_notes.name: Masha Mar
artist_notes.note: Serbian-born, LA-based selector who co-founded Dig Deeper LA and co-runs Take It Outside itself with Heidi Lawden — cosmic disco, deep house and left-field selections.

artist_notes.name: Heidi Lawden
artist_notes.note: LA-via-London selector who cut her teeth in the '90s UK queer rave scene — house/techno/disco marathon sets, longtime DJ Harvey tour collaborator, co-runs this party with Masha Mar.

504b3373a342.curator_note: Masha Mar and Heidi Lawden's own day-into-night party keeps expanding — Dor Wand opening on ambient before the room turns into soulful house is exactly the arc this lane loves, and with Lovefingers, Perfect Lovers and a run of dublab regulars filling out the bill, this is worth clearing the whole Saturday for.
504b3373a342.description: Take It Outside's day-into-night open-air party at The Bridge, DTLA (6pm-3am), moving from live ambient into soulful house, disco and Balearic across five back-to-back pairings including co-founders Masha Mar and Heidi Lawden, Lovefingers and Perfect Lovers.

artist_notes.name: Mario Liberti
artist_notes.note: Peru-born DJ who cut his teeth in Miami (residencies at Techno Loft, Club Space, Un_Mute) and is now based between Lima, Miami and Paris — founder of Deep In Dis, the label/party series this showcase is named for; deep, hypnotic techno and house.

artist_notes.name: Chemtrail Johnny
artist_notes.note: SoCal DJ/producer working in minimal, laid-back house and techno grooves — low profile but a real local scene name.

44f329b4a7f9.curator_note: Mario Liberti flying in to host his own Deep In Dis showcase is a legitimate deep-techno booking; I couldn't verify CHOíCE, Hazy or Mikeb, so treat this as a solid headliner riding on an unknown undercard.
44f329b4a7f9.description: TBA-location DTLA techno showcase from the Deep In Dis series, headlined by founder Mario Liberti with Chemtrail Johnny, CHOíCE, Hazy and Mikeb, 11pm start.

artist_notes.name: DJ Tennis
artist_notes.note: Manfredi Romano — Italian scene godfather who founded Life and Death in 2010 (Tale Of Us, Mind Against and Carlita all came up through the label); a globally touring, melodic house/techno selector with real ties to the Innervisions crowd via the Rakastella festival.

artist_notes.name: Kaz James
artist_notes.note: Australian DJ/producer with old-school pedigree — a decade-long Pacha Ibiza residency (Nic Fanciulli's 'We Are The Night') behind him, now making straight-up house that's charted with tracks like 'Not in Love' and 'Footprints.'

artist_notes.name: Masha Mar
artist_notes.note: Serbian-born, LA-based DJ/curator (the Midnight Lovers crew) with NTS and Dublab residencies — Italo disco, house and dancefloor edits.

84882da12558.curator_note: Âme running an actual outdoor Chinatown block party — not a warehouse pop-up or a festival stage — is exactly the kind of booking worth clearing a Saturday for; DJ Tennis and Masha Mar rounding out the bill only sweetens it.

artist_notes.name: Floorplan
artist_notes.note: Robert Hood & daughter Lyric Hood — Detroit techno royalty (M-Plant) turned deep, gospel-inflected house. 'Baby Baby' fills a floor for a reason.

artist_notes.name: HoneyLuv
artist_notes.note: Cleveland-born, ex-Navy — one of the biggest tech-house breakouts of the last few years; soulful, groovy end of the genre, runs her own 4 Tha Luv label.

artist_notes.name: Hannah Laing
artist_notes.note: Dundee DJ, ex-dental technician turned fast-rising UK name — high-energy trance and hard house, runs the doof label and just launched her own festival.

artist_notes.name: Coco & Breezy
artist_notes.note: Twin sisters (also the eyewear-brand founders) turned house/dance DJ duo — danceable, R&B-tinged, more crossover-pop energy than underground.

artist_notes.name: STRAWBRY
artist_notes.note: LA underground fixture (South Florida-raised) — breaks-and-house sets, runs the STUDIO5400 party series.

artist_notes.name: Vieze Asbak
artist_notes.note: Dutch 'memecore'/troll-rave artist out of Amsterdam's Pestcore Collectief — hard-dance-adjacent chaos, not clean house or techno. A sign this bill gets weird in spots.

artist_notes.name: Jazzy (IRL)
artist_notes.note: Couldn't pin down a confident bio for this one — flagging as unverified rather than guessing.

b55dc359c0e1.curator_note: Boiler Room's Sunday day party stacks Floorplan's gospel house and HoneyLuv's tech-house heat against Hannah Laing's hard-house hype and a Dutch memecore act, with several names even RA barely has bios for — genuinely one of the most eclectic single-day bills on the radar, go in expecting variety over consistency.

dj nuts.note: Sao Paulo crate-digger revered for his Brazilian/global-beats edits (Wax Poetics 'Cultura Copia' mixtapes) — deep, eclectic, all-vinyl selector.

cut chemist.note: LA turntablist, ex-Jurassic 5 / Ozomatli — sample-collage funk and breaks; a foundational figure in the city's beats scene.

waajeed.note: Detroit producer/DJ (Bling47, Dirt Tech Reck) and Slum Village affiliate — soulful house and beats that bridge Dilla's lineage into the dancefloor.

shdw.note: Co-founder of the Mutual Rytm label and half of German duo SHDW & Obscure Shape — driving, hypnotic, melodic-leaning techno; squarely the refined European end you like.

bradley zero.note: Founder of Peckham's Rhythm Section International and the long-running NTS show — a genuine tastemaker selector spanning disco, broken beat, deep house and global grooves. One of the better daytime sets you can catch in LA this weekend.

masha mar.note: Serbian-born, LA-based DJ/curator (the Midnight Lovers crew) with NTS and Dublab residencies — Italo disco, house and dancefloor edits.

neeko.note: Resident selector for Sunday Sessions LA, the vinyl-only series at Apotheke — all-wax house and disco.

krane.note: Longtime Sunday Sessions LA resident — vinyl-only house DJ recorded across the series' open-air sets.

ayybo.note: Rising US tech-house producer, big-room festival energy — exactly the mainstream-fun end of the lane, not noise.

ragie ban.note: Brazilian house producer signed to Lake's own Black Book; their flip 'Toxic' hit Beatport #1.

dj minx.note: Detroit house matriarch, Women on Wax founder — tracked artist; deep, soulful, dancefloor-first selection.

josh caffé.note: London house vocalist/DJ and Paranoid London frontman; Black queer club energy with records on Crosstown Rebels and Classic — proper fabric-lineage stuff.

farralone.note: LA disco/house selector — couldn't verify a label home, but the billing reads classic nu-disco-into-house warmth.

trovarsi.note: LA modular/live techno artist and educator (SoCal Synth Society) — bassy, hardware-driven sets that swing from pounding to melodic.

e m bae.note: Part of the Black Techno Matters collective lineup; couldn't verify a full bio, so taking that at face value.

92jelani.note: Black Techno Matters-affiliated DJ; limited public footprint, included per the billing.

hot since 82.note: UK house heavyweight, Knee Deep In Sound boss — tracked artist; rolling, hypnotic, extended-set sensibility that elevates the whole bill.

claude vonstroke.note: Dirtybird founder (aka Barclay Crenshaw) — playful, bass-heavy West Coast house; he's billed leading the 'Team USA' set here.

ardalan.note: Tehran-born, Bay Area-raised Dirtybird mainstay — hypnotic, deep-bass house out of the Sunset Sound System lineage.

todd edwards.note: New Jersey UK-garage legend ('God of Garage') who shaped Daft Punk's sound — chopped-vocal, skippy house.

cut snake.note: Australian house duo (Sedz & Leigh Sedley) — sunny, festival-ready CRSSD-circuit house.

falcons.note: LA producer/DJ working the club-and-bass-leaning end; included per the bill.

ak chamel the giver of illness.note: Anonymous Houston duo doing desert-scorched ritual-folk and lo-fi psychedelia — masked, costumed, occult live show; fits the Zebulon experimental lane more than the dance one.

derek monypeny.note: Joshua Tree guitarist/oud + shahi baaja player (ex-Sir Richard Bishop's Freak of Araby Ensemble) — drone-to-free-jazz 'desert continuum' soundscapes.

xica soul.note: LA DJ and radio host (Artform, KQBH) — soul, funk and house, an In Sheep's Clothing-circuit selector.

cassian.note: Australian producer, Grammy-winning mixer on RÜFÜS DU SOL's 'Alive' — dark-but-dreamy melodic house; the marquee draw here.

kamino.note: London/LA/Brooklyn house & tech-house producer; broke out with 'Lower Frequency,' melody-forward but dancefloor-aimed.

eddie c.note: Canadian-in-Berlin slo-mo disco-edits heavyweight (Edward Currelly) — lush, dubby, generous grooves on Endless Flight; runs the 7 Inches of Love imprint with The Mole. A tracked name and a perfect open-to-close selector.

b wade.note: Resident behind the recurring 'Acts of Service Sounds' soulful-house night at Gold Diggers — 'sounds for the soul, all night long,' classic vocal/gospel-tinged deep house.

lydo.note: NYC-based, BASEMENT resident and X-TRA.SERVICES founder — fast, syncopated, heady techno-trance from the queer underground.

frankie teardrop.note: Montreal DJ/curator (Slut Island festival, LIP party) — high-energy queer-underground techno and rave.

tamara lanza.note: LA multi-genre DJ and Level 8 / Sunset Sessions regular — ranges disco house through deep and melodic; reliable rooftop-groove selector.

antal.note: Rush Hour co-founder, Amsterdam — one of the deepest diggers alive; obscure disco, raw house, broken beat and beyond. Flying in for this. A tracked name.

reverberation radio.note: The Allah-Las' long-running weekly podcast and DJ crew — deep-crate '60s-onward psych, surf, folk-rock, soul and global obscurities played off the records (Calico Discos label).

richie hawtin.note: Windsor/Detroit-Berlin minimal-techno icon (Plastikman, F.U.S.E.; founder of Plus 8 and M_nus) — a defining name in stripped, hypnotic techno. A tracked name; this is a free art-context set, not a club.

john gerrard.note: Irish artist behind LACMA's year-long browser-based 'SPIRITS' artwork; this solstice event is its Summer (Mediterranean) activation — gerrard appears alongside Hawtin.

dave harrington.note: Half of Darkside (with Nicolas Jaar) and a fixture of LA's improv scene — guitar/electronics-led psychedelic jams; this is his quintet.

john dwyer.note: Frontman of Oh Sees / Osees — prolific garage-psych and experimental bandleader (Castle Face Records), here in a free-improv setting.

spencer zahn.note: Composer and double-bassist working in ambient-jazz and modern-classical textures (collaborations with Dawn Richard among others).

aaron steele.note: LA/Nashville drummer-percussionist (Chrome Sparks and others) — versatile, jazz-fusion-leaning player.

tom dolas.note: Keyboardist in Oh Sees and Mr. Elevator — psych and jazz-fusion-flavored synth and keys.

yaeji.note: Brooklyn-based, Korean-American producer/DJ (Kathy Yaeji Lee) — whispered bilingual vocals over deep house and club rhythms; debut LP 'What We Drew' on XL Recordings, second album 'With A Hammer' (2023). Breakthrough Boiler Room in 2017. On a dedicated DJ-set North American summer tour 2026. Tracked name.

alima lee.note: LA-based DJ and co-founder of the Baexploitation / Hood Rave orbit — global club, footwork-adjacent and deeply communal sets.

adam beyer.note: Swedish techno institution and Drumcode founder — driving, functional, peak-time techno; one of the most reliably excellent festival techno sets alive. Tracked name.

cloonee.note: Manchester-raised tech-house producer Dave Bissett (CLNE, Repopulate Mars, Sola) — Beatport #1s including 'Like What' and a Chris Lake collab 'Nightmares'; one of the circuit's best crowd-movers. Tracked name.

loco dice.note: Tunisian-German DJ Yassine Ben Achour, Düsseldorf — founder of Desolat; Space/Hi Ibiza resident; blends hip-hop textures and North African rhythms into house and tech house. Records on Ovum, M-nus, Cadenza, Cocoon.

hi-lo.note: Oliver Heldens' darker techno alias — HILOMATIK label boss; has released on Drumcode and deadmau5's mau5trap; melodic-peak techno bridging festival and underground.

elderbrook.note: London singer-producer Alexander Kotz — 'Cola' with CamelPhat was Grammy-nominated 2018; soulful voice over emotive deep house. Live-electronic act, not a DJ set.

hayden james.note: Sydney producer — polished, melodic house (multi-Platinum 'Something About You'); worked with Gorgon City and Katy Perry; RUFUS Du Sol-adjacent but slightly more radio-pop.

sidepiece.note: LA-based duo Party Favor + Nitti Gritti — their 2019 'On My Mind' was Grammy-nominated for Best Dance Recording; peak-time tech house with Motown and '90s soul edits.

westend.note: New York tech house producer Tyler Morris — helped define modern American tech house; Kick & Bass Records founder; recent single 'The Ceiling' on John Summit's Experts Only.

josh baker.note: Manchester DJ/producer and You&Me Records founder — groove-heavy fluid house and minimal; played fabric, DC10, The Warehouse Project; also runs SYNTHO production school.

riordan.note: South-coast UK rising producer — garage-influenced tech house; Beatport #1 'Needle On The Record' on Gorgon City's Realm; also on Black Book and Catch & Release.

greg 99.note: Brazilian producer from Minas Gerais — Latin and Afro-inflected tech house; Beatport #1 collab 'Still My Baby' with Cloonee (6.6M streams); Insomniac Records debut.

stacey pullen.note: Second-wave Detroit techno architect — studied under Derrick May, released on R&S, Transmat and Eclipse in the '90s; Blackflag Recordings founder; acclaimed DJ-Kicks (1996); also releases as Bango, Kosmik Messenger and Silent Phase. Tracked name.

bae bae.note: Kumi James — LA-born DJ/producer, sound artist, Planet Mu signee, and co-founder of Hood Rave (DTLA's queer-Black underground party). Sets weave footwork, juke, breaks and R&B through an explicitly Black-diasporic and femme lens; NTS and Dublab radio host.

nish.note: LA/Boracay-raised DJ — groove-forward soulful house and global rhythms with an intention-first approach; active in the Westside Bounce and LA underground circuits.

dj toka.note: Resident at Sudamericana, LA's long-running Latin dance party (founded 2012) — plays between classic South American rhythms, house and disco edits in an unpretentious, inclusive room.

robert hood.note: Detroit minimal-techno originator and M-Plant founder — co-founded Underground Resistance with Jeff Mills and Mad Mike Banks; stripped techno to bare drum/bassline essentials on 'Internal Empire' and 'Minimal Nation' (both 1994, Tresor/Axis). Also records as Floorplan (gospel-inflected house). Tracked name.

disco zombie.note: LA techno DJ and producer active in the WORK / Dirty Epic underground orbit — dark, groovy techno; co-hosts the @earlyafters show on KCHUNG Radio.

onyx.note: LA-based underground techno DJ, active on the WORK / INCOGNITO circuit; limited wider public footprint beyond local bookings.

rubbermiro.note: LA techno DJ (KCHUNG Radio earlyafters host alongside Disco Zombie) — dark, groovy underground techno; regular on the Dirty Epic / WORK circuit.

jayda g.note: Vancouver-born, London-based producer/DJ Jacinda Gulley — environmental toxicologist turned Grammy-nominated house and disco selector; two albums on Ninja Tune including 'Guy' (2023). An instinctive digger with genuine soul. Tracked name.

enayet.note: NYC-based, Dhaka-raised producer and SLINK co-founder — debut EP 'Chokkor' recorded in Bangladesh; polyrhythmic club music with South Asian vocal/percussion textures; collaborated with Daytimers and Talvin Singh.

k wata.note: NYC producer Kenzo Perron, SLINK co-founder — experimental grooves between warehouse electro, trap and psychedelic reggaeton; produced for Yaeji; contributed to james K 'Friend' remix album.

discostan.note: LA collective/label co-founded by Arshia Fatima Haq and Jeremy Loudenback — archives and decolonizes the dancefloor through South/West Asian and North African music: '80s diaspora disco, folkloric sounds, re-edits and political interventions. Featured in Pitchfork, The Guardian, KCRW.

pocari g.note: LA-based house DJ active on the local underground circuit; limited wider public footprint.

ashtre.note: LA-based selector on the local house/underground circuit; no verified label or broader profile found.

oso disco.note: LA disco/house DJ; included per billing, limited verifiable detail.

blaze claze.note: LA-based DJ; included per billing, no wider verifiable profile found.

halo varga.note: Brian Varga — Chicago-bred selector, one of fabric London's first resident DJs; releases on All Inn Records, Visionquest, Soma, Yoshitoshi; now San Diego-based and co-owner of Artifact Record Shop. Deep Chicago house roots with a European finish.

dylan payne.note: LA-based vinyl selector and Inthebagg label head — all-vinyl sets of house, microhouse and minimal grooves; Sunday Sessions LA regular.

highkin'.note: Moscow-born, LA-based vinyl collector and DJ — active on the LA underground circuit with an RA profile; limited wider public footprint beyond local bookings.

flying mojito bros.note: British duo Ben Chetwood and Jack Sellen — cosmic country-funk and classic rock reimagined as acid house and modern disco; releases on Ubiquity, Paper Recordings, !K7 and Heavenly. Think Crosby Stills and Nash at the Hacienda.

brainstory.note: LA trio (Inland Empire origin) — jazz-inflected neo-soul, psychedelia and hip-hop textures; primarily a live band, not a DJ act. Some groove DNA but a different lane from the dance floor.

ginger root.note: Cameron Lew's solo project from Huntington Beach — immaculately crafted indie soul, alt-disco, boogie and Japanese city pop; primarily a live band but occasionally performs DJ sets. Influences include Vulfpeck, Toro y Moi and Yellow Magic Orchestra.

eli escobar.note: New York house and disco veteran — 20+ years in the scene, Tiki Disco crew founding member, Night People NYC label boss; sets traverse soulful disco, jazzy house, funk, reggaeton and Afrobeat without losing the floor.

charlotte de witte.note: Belgian techno powerhouse, KNTXT label boss — hard, hypnotic peak-time techno; a tracked name and one of the strongest bookings on this lineup.

boys noize.note: Berlin electro/techno veteran (Alex Ridha) — distorted, industrial-leaning club music going back to the mid-2000s Boysnoize Records run; still a reliably weird, high-energy set.

maceo plex.note: Miami-via-Barcelona producer (Eric Estornel) — tech-house and techno crossover, Ellum Audio boss; deep, dark, groove-driven.

tiga.note: Montreal electro-house institution (Turbo Recordings) — tongue-in-cheek, disco-inflected electro; a real name for the older end of this bill.

vtss.note: Polish DJ/producer on the harder, rave-leaning end of techno — Bicep's Fabric label, T4T LUV NRG co-founder; a genuinely respected underground name amid the festival billing.

shygirl.note: UK rapper/vocalist and NUXXE co-founder — hyperpop-adjacent club music, Sega Bodega/Arca collaborator; more art-club than DJ set.

hannah laing.note: Scottish DJ/producer on the UK hard-house/hardcore-revival wave — high-BPM, rave-nostalgic tech house.

vintage culture.note: Brazilian tech-house export, Solotoko boss — tracked name; huge festival draw, big-room but genuinely well-selected house.

mau p.note: Dutch producer of 'Drugs From Amsterdam' fame — tracked name; big-room tech house with a raw, jacking edge.

dj seinfeld.note: Swedish-Argentine producer (Armand Jakobsson) who pioneered 'lo-fi house' — tracked name; hazy, nostalgic house that's a shade more tasteful than most of this bill.

chris lorenzo.note: UK bass/house producer, Half Baked label — tracked name; UK garage-inflected, bass-heavy house.

interplanetary criminal.note: Manchester producer riding the UK bassline/2-step revival — one of the more interesting names on the bill if you like that skippy, rave-adjacent garage sound.

amelie lens.note: Belgian techno star, Exhale label — tracked name; driving, hypnotic peak-time techno with real European club credibility (see also her own Grand Park date this batch).

andy c.note: UK drum & bass legend, RAM Records boss — outside the house/techno lane but a genuine, decades-deep DJ talent if you catch a set.

polo and pan.note: French duo (Paul Armand-Delille & Alexandre Grynszpan) doing lush, tropical-tinged synth-pop and disco touches — a strong, Balearic-adjacent opening act even if the headliner isn't your lane.

knock2.note: US producer straddling bass music and pop-leaning electronic — big festival-stage energy, outside the house/techno lane.

sacha robotti.note: Berlin-schooled, LA-based producer and Slothacid label founder — house/techno with releases on Dirtybird, Defected and Kompakt; his debut album drops on Dirtybird in 2026, so this booking tracks.

gg.note: Resident behind Townhouse Venice's recurring GOOD GAME party — deep house, hip-hop and global rhythms with rotating guest DJs; a westside underground night, not a marquee-name booking.

la riots.note: Daniel Linton's long-running LA tech-house project (started as a duo in 2007) — bloghouse/remix roots (Justice's 'DVNO'), now festival-circuit groove-driven house on Toolroom and Musical Freedom.

doc martin.note: West Coast house pioneer — moved SF to LA in the early '90s, founded the long-running Sublevel label/party (25 years deep in 2026); deep, tribal, acid-inflected house from a genuine scene elder.

lee burridge.note: UK DJ, founder of All Day I Dream — melodic, organic, Balearic-leaning house; about as close to the European sunset-groove reference point as a festival lineup gets.

justin martin.note: Dirtybird co-founder — bouncy, quirky, bass-inflected West Coast house ('Sasquatch', 'Buggin''); SF scene royalty.

radio slave.note: Matt Edwards' techier alias — Rekids co-founder, ex-Ministry of Sound resident; propulsive, muscular house/techno, a genuinely European-pedigreed booking.

mikey lion.note: Desert Hearts co-founder — psychedelic house/techno out of the SoCal camping-rave scene, warmer and trippier than straight club fare.

dj colette.note: Chicago house vocalist/DJ (Om Records, Skint) — classic Chicago-lineage vocal house, been in the game since the late '90s.

anton tumas.note: Subtract Music founder — deep house/techno/hypnotic-electronica selector who ran the beloved 'Subtract On The Pier' Long Beach series; genuinely well-regarded in the SoCal deep-house underground.

davi.note: Armenian-born, LA-based progressive house producer — early support from Hernan Cattaneo, Nick Warren, John Digweed; polished melodic-prog rather than raw underground.

luke mele.note: LA-based selector with a long-running NTS Radio show spanning Balearic house, dub techno, ambient and trip-hop — a genuine home-listening digger, exactly the vinyl-only lane you like.

taylor shockley.note: House/ambient/minimal/dub DJ with credits on Insomniac and Mixcloud — smaller name, limited verifiable bio beyond active gigging.

nick león.note: Miami producer on TraTraTrax and Future Times — fuses dembow, reggaeton and dancehall rhythm into house/techno (his own coined term: 'arquitectronica'); one of the more genuinely distinctive club producers right now, sun-bleached and heavy in equal measure.

demuir.note: Toronto-based, Chicago-schooled house producer — Beatport's #1 Jacking House producer 2015/2016, credited with creating the 'Jackin House' genre tag; 600+ tracks deep, releases on Hot Creations and Classic. Funky, sexy, groove-first house.

massimiliano pagliara.note: Italian-born, Berlin-based DJ/producer with residencies at Berghain/Basement — Chicago house, Italo-disco and electro-disco worked through analog '70s/'80s hardware; a genuine Live at Robert Johnson / Ostgut Ton pedigree, deeply in the European lane.

james axon.note: LA-based DJ (dublab resident, 'Hearing Color') and founder of the queer underground party Planet Love — deep house, dreamy techno, Italo, Balearic and psych-disco; a real musician's ear (former pianist), has played alongside Octo Octa, Eris Drew, Derrick Carter.

drama.note: Chicago R&B/dance duo — producer Na'el Shehade and vocalist Via Rosa — genre-blurring pop/dance/jazz songwriting; played Coachella alongside Frank Ocean and Gorillaz.

gene on earth.note: San Francisco-born, Berlin-based DJ/producer (Eugene Albert) — runs the Limousine Dream label; deep-digging extended sets drifting through minimal house, breaks and hazy late-night rollers.

collin reeve.note: LA house DJ, regular on the Certified Groovers series — limited verifiable bio beyond his own SoundCloud output and repeat bookings on the bill.

pan pot.note: Berlin duo (Tassilo Ippenberger & Thomas Benedix), Second State label bosses — big, weighty, driving techno; a genuine headliner for a 4-hour extended set.

doostah.note: LA house/techno DJ who works marketing for 6AM Group/WORK/Synthetik Minds — one of the promoters playing support, not an outside booking.

kitty logic.note: Hong Kong-born, LA-based DJ and TRANS*CENDENT co-founder who came up in the warehouse scene — driving techno and trance sets, on the harder/faster end of the spectrum.

neek.note: SoCal DJ/producer who's blown up fast in the hard-techno lane through viral edits and heavy, industrial-leaning production.

dea magna.note: LA techno/hard-techno producer, classically trained, releases on Reinier Zonneveld's Filth On Acid — fuses trance intensity with techno drive.

merimell.note: Estonian hard-techno DJ/producer, Machine Nation founder — one of the harder European exports, industrial textures and peak-time intensity.

kayzo.note: LA bass-music DJ who built his name on hardstyle/dubstep/trap crossover and has recently leaned back into hard dance and hard techno — aggressive, riddim-adjacent, not a selector's night.

blksoap.note: DJ, educator, and Soul Source LA co-founder (also runs Textures) — deep, eclectic sets spanning house, beats and '90s R&B/neo-soul; the resident anchoring this monthly.

kobie dozier.note: LA jazz saxophonist out of the Leimert Park scene (studied with Ricky Washington, Kamasi Washington-adjacent lineage) — his billing here points to a live-jazz element in the room, not a straight DJ set.

shanto.note: LA-based DJ/producer ranging downtempo through deep and indie house to techno — a regular on the city's rooftop/deep-house circuit.

young franco.note: Brisbane-raised, Sydney-based producer (Joseph Da Rin de Barbera) — ARIA-certified pop-leaning dance songs ('Drop Your Love,' a Magic Mike's Last Dance cut), Apple/EA/NFL sync placements. Big, sunny, festival-friendly rather than underground; good-time daytime pool set energy.

okayval.note: Colombian-born, US-based rising DJ/producer blending techno and tech house — Beatport/SoundCloud presence but too new for a fuller bio; billed as the headliner here.

silvertone.note: Philadelphia house/techno producer working minimal tech, bass house and acid — early-career, small footprint, but the sound fits a warehouse late-night.

day thief.note: US DJ/producer (Sophie L) working the underground FLINTA*/queer party circuit out of SF/Oakland and NYC — appears on BASEMENT-adjacent bills; leans dark, all-night warehouse techno.

faited.note: Oakland-based DJ (Fait P) from the Envelope Soundsystem/Eris Drew-Octo Octa orbit — underground queer techno and house circuit, more soundsystem-culture than festival-facing.

township rebellion.note: Berlin/Cologne techno-house duo (Stil vor Talent, Suara) — shadowy, vocal-accented melodic techno that helped shape the Lane 8/Afterlife-adjacent sound; broke wider after a 2019 Burning Man set connected them to Rufus Du Sol's camp.

denyc.note: LA-based artist (Denise Poole) blending live vocals with dance-heavy basslines — still emerging, limited track record.

fun2bjane.note: LA DJ (Jane O'Conner) — INCOGNITO and Sensory Signal resident who's played HARD Summer and Skyline; sets bounce between sassy house/techno and late-'90s prog/trance.

etari.note: LA-based (Orange County-raised) producer and AUNTIE co-founder — house through trance and techno, with releases on 100% Silk; regular on the Lights Down Low/HARD Summer circuit.

rosie love.note: LA underground DJ tied to the Apt4B Radio scene — spins house and techno; limited wider public profile beyond local bookings.

mike servito.note: Detroit-bred, NY-based DJ and longtime Bunker NYC resident — jacking, unpretentious sets that move fluidly through house, acid and techno; a fixture of the queer-underground warehouse circuit for two-plus decades.

jason kendig.note: Detroit-vet DJ and one-quarter of San Francisco's Honey Soundsystem crew — deep, eclectic house/techno selection; frequent Servito collaborator (Honcho, The Black Madonna's We Still Believe tour).

apt4b radio.note: LA collective throwing intimate, no-phones-on-the-floor house/techno/UKG parties in apartments, lofts and small venues — community-first, BIPOC/queer-forward lineups over marquee names.

mura masa.note: Guernsey-born producer Alex Crossan — future bass/alt-R&B crossover, Grammy-nominated for his 2017 debut LP; also produces for Ariana Grande and PinkPantheress. This is a DJ set, not the full live production.

zepparella.note: All-female Led Zeppelin tribute band out of San Francisco (formed 2005) — no original material, note-for-note recreations with genuine musicianship.

adam spry.note: Bay Area indie-folk/alt-rock songwriter, likened to The Shins and Fruit Bats — plays warm, nostalgic guitar pop.

the pretty flowers.note: LA indie-rock four-piece led by Noah Green, three albums in (most recent 'Never Felt Bitter' on Forge Again Records, 2026) — hooky, literate underground rock, well-regarded on the local circuit.

markus schulz.note: German-American trance veteran (Coldharbour Recordings founder, longtime top-10 DJ Mag placement) — progressive trance with techno and D&B influences. Well outside the house/techno lane; a big trance name, not a groove/European-house one.

beau didier.note: Amsterdam DJ/producer (b. 1999) and Vulged co-founder — bass-heavy, vocal-driven hard groove/techno; releases on Molekül and Mutual Rytm, plays HÖR Berlin and Awakenings. Making his LA debut here.

ötak.note: Recurring THERMAL support DJ — hard/industrial techno, releases on 44 Label Group and Dolma Records; a known quantity on this specific TBA-warehouse circuit rather than a marquee name.

kyrxmi.note: Phoenix-via-LA techno DJ, EvilGroove label affiliate — deep, driving, hypnotic groove techno; plays the Southern California TBA-warehouse circuit.

kana hishiya.note: Japan-born, LA-based DJ/producer — house and techno moving between punchy, minimal and broken-beat, with dreamy melodic turns; played MEOKO and Sirens LA podcast series.

bilaliwood.note: NYC/LA DJ, ex-child actor — plays tasteful, left-of-center selections across genres; regular on the DāM-Funk/Fusicology TBA-party orbit.

stavroz.note: Belgian four-piece live band — organic, cinematic electronic music blending acoustic textures with emotive melodies (breakout tracks 'The Finishing,' 'Gold Town'); Coachella and Pukkelpop alumni, half a million-plus monthly Spotify listeners. A live act, not a DJ set.

orion 224.note: Houston indie/alt-rock four-piece (formed 2016) fronted by Cristian Gonzalez — melodic guitar-driven indie rock.

cannon the dealers.note: Brownsville, TX 'indie-sleaze' four-piece — nostalgic early-2000s indie rock/shoegaze/hardcore blend, Strokes/Red Pears lineage; touring behind their album 'Still Too Soon.'

dj slugo.note: Chicago ghetto-house/footwork pioneer, founding Dance Mania crew alongside DJ Deeon and Paul Johnson — raw, high-BPM, chant-hook club tracks; the sound Daft Punk sampled on 'Teachers.'

scotty boy.note: Vegas-based house veteran (25+ years, three Billboard Dance #1s) and founder of DTLA's long-running 'Deep House Brunch' — plays crowd-friendly deep/jackin' house and nu-disco edits, more festival-polish than underground digger.

nikki nair.note: Atlanta producer/DJ blending techno, electro, breaks and UK bass into something genre-agnostic and physical — releases on Dirtybird and Lobster Theremin, mentored early by Underground Resistance's Mike Banks.

george daniel.note: The 1975's drummer moonlighting as a dance producer/DJ — founded the label dh2 out of afterparty DJ sets; plays bass-leaning, UK-rap-inflected electronic sets, not a genre veteran but a genuine crate-digger's side project.
